sourceChecks.sourceText: Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
sourceChecks.previousContext: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
sourceChecks.nextContext: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.
